let a: number;
let b: string;
({ a } = { a: 1 });
console.log(a);
[a, b] = [2, 'x'];
console.log(a, b);
[a = 1, [b]] = [3, ['y']];
console.log(a, b);
const point = { x: 0, label: '' };
[point.x, point.label] = [5, 'z'];
console.log(point);
({ x: a, y: b } = { x: 1, y: 's' });
console.log(a, b);
let rest: (string | number)[];
[a, ...rest] = [1, 'a', 2];
console.log(a, rest);
let counts: Map<string, number>;
let values: number[];
[counts, values] = [new Map(), [1]];
console.log(counts.size, values);
